author: blu
body: Proves X spells. "Fireball deals X damage" compiles to DealDamageX; the AI pours all mana left after the fixed cost into X and points it at the face for lethal or at the biggest creature it kills. Before this the X misparsed to a flat 1. x-castable also stops the pilot from firing an X spell with no spare mana (X = 0).
